entries.1987e405853b86b2: It has an integrated production system that can complete within the group all the processes necessary for manufacturing cemented carbide tools and molds: mixing raw material powders (powder preparation), producing materials through forming and sintering (metallurgy), processing into tools and molds, and measuring and inspecting dimensions and shapes.
